items.text: Puka Nacua (hip) will not practice and is listed as doubtful vs Broncos; McVay believes barring setback he could return next week vs Eagles.
items.why: Hip injury, multiple DNPs, McVay cautious on soft tissue
items.implication: Sit Nacua; elevate Adams to WR1
items.opportunity: Davante Adams routes/targets spike without Nacua

items.text: Jayden Daniels will not be placed on IR; week-to-week after imaging/specialists, aiming return ASAP; only ruled out this week vs Seahawks.
items.why: Consensus after evals; positive news post-uncertainty
items.implication: Hold Daniels; stream QB short-term; McLaurin still viable but matchup-dependent

items.text: Nico Collins (hamstring) DNP second straight day; not expected to play vs Colts.
Jonathon Brooks expected IR (core); only 5 games in 3 seasons; Chuba Hubbard firmly lead back (RB14 util), AJ Dillon primary backup.
items.why: Core injury, history of limited play
items.opportunity: Hubbard full lead role + Dillon handcuff

items.text: Packers WR routes without Jayden Reed (neck/back): Christian Watson 45, Matthew Golden 44 on 55 Love dropbacks; Watson+Golden 48% targets so far.
items.why: First game sans Reed; high route shares
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets for Watson/Golden in 2-TE or without Reed

items.text: Kyle Pitts only 63% routes this season, 6 targets/8% share through 3 games; TPRR 33% London off vs 17% on last two seasons.
items.why: Low route/target share; dependent on London absence
items.implication: Fade Pitts unless London out; London primary
items.opportunity: Limited TE opportunity with London on field
items.conflict: Any Pitts start recs ignore low share

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop 88.5; DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.why: Elite matchup vs weak rush D, high prop

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches +15% tgt share both games, RB7 util; PIT allows 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
items.opportunity: High snap/touch share vs soft PIT run D

items.text: Loves Chris Olave vs LV (double-digit tgts, high aDOT/air yards; LV allows league-high ypr to WRs); Dalton Schultz @IND (28% tgt share sans Collins, IND 4th-most TE yds); Christian Watson vs ATL (WR8 util, high RZ share).
items.opportunity: Olave air yards; Schultz TE monopoly sans Collins; Watson routes/RZ

items.text: Hates Rhamondre Stevenson @JAX (31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble; JAX stout vs RBs); Travis Etienne vs LV (49% touches/38% 3rd-down snaps even w/ Kamara).
items.opportunity: Henderson rise in NE; limited Etienne role

items.text: Henderson led NE snaps 65%/out-touched Stevenson 16-5 post-fumble (still ranks Stevenson ahead W3); Schultz 30% routes/28% tgt share sans Collins, faces IND TE-friendly. London 20+ PPR/35% share/97 yds w/ Penix.
items.implication: Monitor NE committee closely; start Schultz/London confidently
items.opportunity: Henderson role expansion; Schultz monopoly; London-Penix chemistry

items.text: Bills list WR D.J. Moore questionable Sunday (shoulder).
items.opportunity: Potential target bump for other Bills WRs

items.text: Nick Bosa calf pull in practice; expected miss few weeks incl vs Cards; 49ers leaning no IR due to space limits.
items.implication: SF defense weaker; slight boost Cards/offense

items.text: Hates Terry McLaurin vs SEA (fewest FP to WRs, low ypr allowed; WAS low total); Rome Odunze vs PHI (12% tgt share, high aDOT, Quinyon Mitchell, low CHI total).
